subject: storytime
title: Dog Man words
about: Dog Man has the head of a police dog and the body of a police officer, and he chases a sneaky cat named Petey around the city in comic-book pictures. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together, with him reading the speech bubbles.

book.author: Dav Pilkey
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: Part dog, part cop, all hero, drawn like a comic book.

passage.text:
dog cat man cop
Petey chief head body
good bad jail robot
comic draw bone chase
fetch city

cards.note: capital P, it is the cat's name; the e says its name and ey says ee: Pee-tee
ch is one part; ie says ee: cheef
ea says short e here, like in bread: hed
y at the end says ee: bod-ee
oo says the short oo, like in book
ai says long a, like in rain
two parts: ro-bot; the first o says its name: roh-bot
d-r blend; aw says aw, like in saw
magic e makes o say its name
ch is one part; magic e makes a say its name
tch is one sound, like ch
the c says s and y at the end says ee: sit-ee
